component.name: COSMIC Agent Terminal
component.summary: COSMIC Terminal for coding agents, on this computer and others

description.p: A fork of COSMIC Terminal for working with coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, across several machines.

ul.li: Sessions that outlive their tabs, listed in a sidebar across every machine, with each conversation's title and latest output
Tabs that move between windows and machines
Each machine's files mounted on the others when needed
Agents' sudo approved from the terminal, by password, fingerprint or click, without sending a password to any machine
Saved passwords in an encrypted store with an unlocking policy
